6. Key finding from console crate `unix_term.rs`:
   - `read_bytes()` returns `Err(UnexpectedEof)` when `libc::read` returns 0 (true EOF)
   - But in raw mode (which `read_key()` uses), Ctrl+D sends byte `0x04`, NOT EOF

      fn yes_no_key_action(
          key: &Key,
          options: &[PromptOption],
          sel: &mut usize,
      ) -> Result<Option<usize>> {
          match key {
              Key::Char('y') | Key::Char('Y') => {
                  Ok(options.iter().position(|o| o.value == "yes"))
              }
              Key::Char('n') | Key::Char('N') => {
                  Ok(options.iter().position(|o| o.value == "no"))
              }
              Key::Enter | Key::Char(' ') => Ok(Some(*sel)),
              Key::Char('\x04') => Err(BivvyError::Io(std::io::Error::new(

                  "Aborted (Ctrl+D)",

              Key::ArrowDown | Key::Tab | Key::Char('j') => {
                  *sel = (*sel + 1) % options.len();
                  Ok(None)
              }
              Key::ArrowUp | Key::BackTab | Key::Char('k') => {
                  *sel = (*sel + options.len() - 1) % options.len();
                  Ok(None)
              }
              _ => Ok(None),
          }
      }
